terra-agent-interaction.alt: OpenAI stacked bar chart titled Unauthorized Agent Interaction, lower is better, showing engagement given discovery for seven models. terra-agent-interaction.caption: Figure 12 of OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra addendum, section 7.5.1: across 80 samples in ten simulated scenarios, how often each model engaged with planted agent messages and how often it performed the specified unauthorized action. Rates are conditioned on finding the message board, which every model did. OpenAI's own evaluation in simulated environments, not deployment incidents.

redwood-sce-safety.alt: Two-panel chart from Redwood Research's paper. Left: safety in percent against audit budgets of 0 to 10% for five monitors, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 Mini, GPT-5.4 Nano, GPT-5 Nano, and GPT-5.6 Sol, with simulated (solid) and executed (dashed) curves closely overlapping. Right: prediction error at a 5% audit budget in percentage points: simulation 3.57 against BashArena 10.10 overall; 4.57 against a LinuxArena SD of 20.23 and BashArena 24.70 across side-task categories; 6.01 against 12.90 and 17.30 across environments.
redwood-sce-safety.caption: Figure 8 of Redwood Research's simulated control evaluations paper (arXiv v1): in LinuxArena, safety predicted from simulated tool responses closely tracks executed runs, with a pooled error of 3.6 percentage points against 10.1 for BashArena. Fidelity was checked only in LinuxArena; transfer to production systems is untested.
redwood-sce-safety.credit: Jeffrey Olmo, David Zhang, and Tyler Tracy (Redwood Research)
redwood-sce-safety.changes: Vector Figure 8 rendered from page 9 of the arXiv v1 PDF at 300 dpi and cropped to the figure without its caption; no other changes.

reprobait-fidelity.alt: Line chart, panel a of Figure 3 in the ReproBAIT paper: reproduction fidelity in percent against implementation complexity score for four coding agents. On CMD (25.7) all reach about 100% of the released-tool baseline; on ProteinMPNN (42.7) about 73% to 97%; on RFdiffusion3 (72.9) Claude Opus 5 and Kimi K3 reach about 11% and 13%, and GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-2.4T are marked at zero.
reprobait-fidelity.caption: Panel a of Figure 3 in the AISI and SecureBio ReproBAIT paper (arXiv v1), shown without the other panels: best-of-three fidelity of agent-built tools on each original's primary metric, given the full paper and training data. One metric per tool, not full capability; no agent reproduced RFdiffusion3.
